desc: Frame interpolation by replay at 120 Hz in real time (no TTYD_FAST: paced as a player sees it), a walk in gor_01 (12 s): the time from a game frame's logic (its input read) to its picture shown and to its first in-between frame logged ([latency]) and the recording's cost ([interp-replay] stats); run with --env TTYD_INTERP_MODE=redraw for the old path's numbers
